questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

We must learn to __negotiate__ with every difficult situation in life.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**Disagree**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given word in the sentence is '**negotiate**'. '**Negotiate**' is used to describe a process where individuals or groups have a discussion in order to reach an agreement. (समझौता करना)

 
 
• **Example**: The two countries failed to **negotiate **a peace treaty.
 
 
 
• The correct antonym here is '**disagree**'. '**Disagree**' refers to having or expressing a different opinion. (असहमत होना)
 
 
• **Example**: My friend and I always **disagree **on movie preferences.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct antonym for '**negotiate**' is '**disagree**'.

Therefore, the correct answer is "**Option 2**".

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1: '**Discuss**' is not an antonym for 'negotiate'. 'Discuss' means to talk about something with another person or a group. (चर्चा करना)
 
• Option 3: '**Practice**' is not related to 'negotiate' in terms of being an antonym or synonym. 'Practice' refers to the regular repetition of an activity to improve a skill. (अभ्यास करना)
 
• Option 4: '**Bargain**' can often be synonymous with 'negotiate' as it refers to negotiation of terms and conditions in an agreement or transaction. (मोल-भाव करना)

questions.question:

The husband __promised the earth__ to his wife.
questions.solution:

__
 
• The underlined idiom in the sentence is '**promised the earth**'. It is an idiom used to describe someone promising more than they can deliver, often to persuade someone to do something. (असंभव वादे करना)

 
 
• **Example**: Politicians often **promise the earth** to get votes in elections.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct meaning of '**promised the earth**' is '**Promised an impossible thing**'.

Therefore, the correct answer is- "**Option 1**".

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2: '**Promised an inexpensive thing**' is incorrect as the idiom 'promised the earth' has nothing to do with the cheapness or expensiveness of the promise.
 
• Option 3: '**Promised land**' is a different idiom that typically refers to a desired or promised place of happiness or success, not related to 'promised the earth'.
 
• Option 4: '**Promised a necklace**' is also incorrect. The idiom 'promised the earth' has no specific connection with promising a necklace.

The correct answer is **option (3).** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The underlined segment **“eagerly waiting of the quick__”** contains a prepositional error.

 __

• **“Waiting for”- CORRECT.**

• **'Await'** is often used in a more formal context. We **do not **use** 'for'** after **'await'.**
 
 
• **Example:** He awaited the results of the medical test with anxiety.
 
• **Example: **He waited for the results of the medical test with anxiety.

questions.question:
Choose the appropriate meaning of the underlying idiom.

She wants to reach the target __by hook or by crook.__

options.text: By one or the other means

questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**By one or the other means**'.

__
 
• The underlined idiom in the sentence is '**by hook or by crook**'. This idiom means to achieve something by any means necessary, using fair means or foul. (चाहे जैसे भी)

 
 
• **Example**: He's determined to get that job **by hook or by crook**.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct meaning of '**by hook or by crook**' is '**By one or the other means**'.

Therefore, the correct answer is- "**Option 1**".

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• Option 3: '**Without deception**' is also not correct as 'by hook or by crook' doesn't necessarily imply fairness or transparency, rather it even allows foul means if necessary.
 
• Option 4: '**Very rapidly**' is incorrect as the idiom 'by hook or by crook' primarily signifies the determination to achieve something, irrespective of the speed of the process.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution’.

Sea levels __have been risen__ all around the world threatening natural calamities like tsunamis, floods, etc.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **option (3).** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• We all know that due to climate change the sea levels have been rising for the last few decades.
 
• It is a continuous process.
 
• **'risen'** is the past participle form of **'rise'. **It is grammatically incorrect here.
 
• **“are raised”** does not imply a continuous process.
 
• **“will rising”** is grammatically **incorrect**.
 
• Hence, **“have been rising”** is the most appropriate to fill in the blank. It implies a continuous process.
 
• The sentence also becomes a present perfect continuous tense.

Therefore, the correct sentence is *“Sea levels **have been rising**__ all around the world threatening natural calamities like tsunamis, floods, etc.*

questions.question:

• The correct antonym here is '**healthy**'. '**Healthy**' refers to being in good health, strong or robust. It also implies being able to withstand the pressures or rigours of life, which is opposite to '**fragile**'. (स्वस्थ)
 
 
• **Example**: She follows a balanced diet to stay **healthy**.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct antonym for '**fragile**' is '**healthy**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
